title: The spacetime of Cosmopoiesis: its engine and its data
about: The engine (the domains metrology, geodesy, astronomy and the navigation bridge on physis, compiled with g++ 11 or later, natively or in WSL) into data/cache/engines/cosmopoiesis/, and the data it and the page read: JPL's ephemeris DE440s (32 MB), the Moon's DE440 orientation (13 MB), the IERS's Earth orientation and the IANA's leap seconds (refreshed by running their steps again), and the sources of the terrain: ETOPO 2022, the EGM96 geoid, Natural Earth's land, LOLA's coarse grids (about 240 MB), with the finer ones fetched as the page needs them; the place names of both bodies, and the elements of satellites from CelesTrak (refreshed by running their steps again). Some minutes in all.
